authority_note: TEST_ONLY fixture. No real Mikko verdict was fabricated; the only genuine human approval in this repository remains the canary's agent-path approval.

problem.before_hardening: a bare "Shot/edit plan approval: PASS" line anywhere in a planning artifact completed gate 6
problem.after_hardening: every approval had to name a visual-plan digest, so a hand-authored planning set could not be approved at all

HUMAN_AUTHORED.approval_binds_to: deterministic snapshot digest over the five governed artifacts

source_modes.ambiguity: both declared without recorded supersession -> PLANNING_AUTHORITY_AMBIGUOUS
source_modes.cross_mode_reuse: impossible — each mode reads only its own marker field

snapshot_contract.digests: machine-owned body only; the sanctioned human-notes region is excluded so notes stay editable after approval
snapshot_contract.canonical_serialization: snapshot schema + gate id + run id + ordered filename:machine_sha256 pairs
excluded: any file outside the governed set
snapshot_contract.ordering: fixed by GOVERNED_ARTIFACTS, not by directory listing

negative_cases.notes_only_edit: still PASS — sanctioned, and notes cannot smuggle governed content because the digest ignores them

provenance_switches.agent_to_human: requires supersedeAgent; the agent approval does not transfer (HUMAN_PLAN_APPROVAL_DIGEST_UNKNOWN until Mikko re-approves)
provenance_switches.human_to_agent: materializing is refused (PLANNING_AUTHORITY_AMBIGUOUS) even with replaceApproved; authority is released only by explicit retirement, after which the agent path needs its own approval
provenance_switches.no_auto_switch: the presence of a visual plan never flips a declared human package, and the absence of one never declares human authority

canonical_regression: changing approved manual content reopens gate 6: 6/14 -> 5/14, capture-checklist -> shot-edit-plan-review, tracker consistent, zero projection defects
invariant: every gate-6 PASS carries either a valid plan-digest binding or a valid human-snapshot binding; there is no marker-only branch
tests: HA1-HA18 plus the existing AB1-AB11 plan-binding matrix, all green
